geographic_rule: one common rule across all states; no city/state compatibility exception

native_reference_vehicle.afdc_weight_class_interpretation: FHWA Class 2, so AFDC LD/class1-2 is not by itself incompatibility; physical clearances remain unknown

configuration_selection.candidate_unit: one eligible source member, one equipment/connector configuration at the frozen location
configuration_selection.modes: enumerate AC and DC independently; do not let a CHAdeMO DC count hide J1772 AC
configuration_selection.source_eligibility: only frozen safe source IDs, matching source address/coordinates, with original public/location/road eligibility; retain access and equipment provenance
configuration_selection.default_adapters: none; an optional adapter scenario needs vehicle-model/AC-or-DC/network support evidence, not brand-only inference
configuration_selection.selection_rule: prefer positive reported compatible power passing QA; choose maximum vehicle-capped rate among those; if none, use national connector/mode median and retain imputation flag; deterministic source/unit tie-break

power_source.scope: private national source input; join only previously admitted public-safe location/member IDs for location outputs
power_source.temporal_limit: rolling retrieval; do not assert simultaneous capture with the separately frozen station CSV

power_vintage: Snapshot Date 2026-10-27 UTC; local retrieval date 2026-10-26; not the identical retrieval as frozen station CSV; per-port measurement year unknown
missing_power: only fill kW after connector/mode compatibility; never infer compatibility from a missing power value; unavailable national median is an error
power_qa: retain raw values; nonfinite/nonpositive values missing; J1772 L2 reports above 19.2kW flagged against standard reference and treated as unknown in the conservative trial, without removing locations; median remains 6.5 under this QA

derating.status: transparent benchmark engineering assumption, not empirical Rivian full-charge calibration
derating.NREL_89174_evidence: PDF page34, printed page17 assumes grid-input to charger-output energy efficiency 90%; does not establish an average peak-power factor
derating.NREL_71198_evidence: PDF page24, printed page16 models temperature and SOC-dependent DC power; no justification for a universal 0.90 power multiplier
derating.sensitivity: 0.85/0.90/0.95 closed-form charge-time comparison only; not routing/solver evidence
